moves.title: Container transform: a chip opens into a screen
subject: ui-fragment
moves.snippet: <ContainerTransform t={t} start={cue} fromBox={chip} toBox={screen} fromSize={..} toSize={..} from={<Chip/>} to={<Screen/>} />
moves.description: Bounds and corner radius morph on M3 emphasized (long2, film x2 = 1.0s); contents fade through: old out in the first 30%, new in from 30%.

moves.title: Shared axis X: next step
subject: ui-fragment
moves.snippet: <SharedAxis axis="x" t={t} start={cue} from={<A/>} to={<B/>} />  // or m.ViewChange kind='sharedAxisX'
moves.description: Both views slide ~90px the same way on M3 emphasized while the old fades out in the first 35% and the new fades in.

moves.title: Shared axis Y: vertical step
subject: ui-fragment
moves.description: As X, along the vertical axis: for stacked or scrolling sequences.

moves.title: Shared axis Z: into a level
subject: ui-fragment
moves.description: The new view grows in from 80% while the old grows past 110% and fades: going deeper (list to detail). Reverse with back.

moves.title: Fade through: unrelated views
subject: ui-fragment
moves.description: Old fades out in the first 35%, new fades in and grows from 92%: switching between sections that are not related.

moves.title: Fade: a dialog appears
subject: ui-fragment
moves.description: Fades in and grows from 80% (150ms x2, emphasized decelerate); exits with a quicker fade.

moves.title: Emphasized move: a card travels
subject: ui-fragment
moves.description: The M3 emphasized path: slow start, fast middle, long settle. 1.0s (long2 x2).

moves.title: Expressive spring: a card pops in
subject: ui-fragment
moves.description: M3 Expressive fast spatial spring (damping 0.6, stiffness 800, slowed 2x for film): a visible overshoot.

moves.title: Apple smooth: a card glides
subject: ui-fragment
moves.description: A critically damped spring (bounce 0): no overshoot, a natural physical settle.

moves.title: Apple snappy: a chip pops
subject: ui-fragment
moves.description: A small bounce (0.15): lively but controlled. Good for UI chips and buttons.

moves.title: Apple bouncy: a badge pops
subject: ui-fragment
moves.description: A noticeable bounce (0.3). Use sparingly, for a moment of delight.

moves.title: Icon bounce
subject: icons
moves.description: Quick squash then a springy lift and settle: a tap, a "done".

moves.title: Icon pulse
subject: icons
moves.description: Opacity dips and returns on repeat: working on it.

moves.title: Icon breathe
subject: icons
moves.description: Size and opacity swell and recede together: alive, waiting.

moves.title: Icon wiggle
subject: icons
moves.description: A decaying side to side rotation: look here.

moves.title: Icon rotate
subject: icons
moves.description: Continuous rotation: in progress.

moves.title: Icon appear
subject: icons
moves.description: Springs in from nothing with a small overshoot.

moves.title: Icon replace
subject: icons
moves.description: The old icon shrinks and blurs out while the new one springs up in its place.

moves.title: Words sharpen in
subject: typography
moves.snippet: m.textReveal(t, cue, i)  // blur 10px to 0, rise 18px, per word
moves.description: The soft profile's headline: each word arrives fast and lands soft, sharpening from blur, 0.1s apart.

moves.title: Camera glides in
subject: ui-fragment
moves.description: The kit camera curve: eases off the mark, fast middle, long soft landing. Never under 0.9s.

moves.title: Blur through: the blur is the cut
subject: ui-fragment
moves.description: Old view blurs out and drifts up, the new one sharpens in from below: a cut without a cut.

moves.title: Liquid glass pill appears
subject: ui-fragment
moves.description: A refracting glass pill springs up over moving content: lensing at the rim, lit edge, soft shadow.

moves.title: Liquid glass splits and merges
subject: ui-fragment
moves.snippet: <LiquidGlass shapes={[pill, bubble]} blend={70} ... />  // move bubble.cx with a spring
moves.description: A drop pulls out of the pill with a liquid neck and rejoins it: shapes within blend px melt together.

moves.title: Liquid glass morphs into a card
subject: ui-fragment
moves.snippet: shapes={[{cx, cy, w: lerp(560, 760, k), h: lerp(124, 380, k), r}]}  // k = m.move(t, cue)
moves.description: The pill grows into a card on M3 emphasized; refraction and rim follow the shape.

moves.title: Grey-to-ink words
subject: typography
moves.snippet: m.word(t, cue, i, ink)  // with a profile whose text style is greyToInk: land light grey, darken to ink
moves.description: A calm text reveal: words land light grey ~0.11s apart and darken to ink over ~0.3s, with a 6px rise. No blur, no bounce. Any profile can use it with text: {style: 'greyToInk'}.
